entities.summary: Marcelle Barbey-Gampert (1895–1987) was a Swiss botanist, geologist, and climatologist noted for phytogeographical studies of the Picos de Europa. The standard author abbreviation Barb.-Gamp. is used to indicate this person as the author when citing a botanical name.
